findings.text: blocking: `if not measured.real: return` treats an unreadable measurement as a clean one, so a coordinator landing whose population measure could not be taken (no resolvable head, a missing worktree, no base revision, an unbuildable base checkout, or a stored unreadable record) merges with nothing reported; the sibling caller at reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1421 routes the same measurement through _measure_guard and raises on unreadable, and _measure_delivery's own contract says an unreadable measurement exists so the caller refuses rather than inferring a verdict from nothing.

non-blocking: the three cases cover a reddening head, a clean head and a base-carried failure but none covers the unreadable measurement arm, so the fail-open at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:4948 is unguarded and a regression that makes every measure unreadable would leave all three green.

item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names three cases and a negative control; tests/test_a_coordinator_landing_is_measured.py:209,233,249 implement them and the manifest records the gate and both arms.
item_verdicts.goal: The goal is to measure a coordinator's landing over the lander's own population; reckon/crew_run_commands.py:4911 and reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1280 implement it, with the unreadable arm at :4948 left permissive.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The declared paths are reckon/crew_run_commands.py, reckon/crew/queue_landing.py, the new test file and the evidence fragment.

justifications.durability: The recorded negative control reddens test_a_head_that_reddens_an_importer_test_is_refused_naming_it when the call is absent, but the unreadable arm at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:4948 has no case in tests/test_a_coordinator_landing_is_measured.py.
justifications.evidence: The three cases the done_when names are in tests/test_a_coordinator_landing_is_measured.py:209,233,249 and pass, and the after arm records 61 passed / EXIT=0 at reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1280's revision.
justifications.fit: measure_a_coordinator_landing at reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1280 follows the sibling _promoted_candidate's use of _stored_measurement, but unlike that caller (queue_landing.py:1421) it does not route the measure through _measure_guard's unreadable refusal.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew_run_commands.py:4942 takes the lander's population measure on `crew complete --land`, but reckon/crew_run_commands.py:4948 lets an unreadable measurement through, so part of the goal's guard is fail-open.
justifications.reuse: The new function reuses _measure_delivery, _stored_measurement, _primary_revision and _measure_guard rather than adding a second measurement mechanism; the capability owner is reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:1126.
justifications.scope_discipline: All four changed paths sit inside the declared write paths; the figures directory was declared and correctly left untouched.
